advisory.heading: When you select a technical noun
advisory.text: For a Rule, use the file-size limit and the extraction recommendation of the entry file that contains its text.
advisory.problem: In skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/loading-rules.md, line 100 uses the technical noun "extraction recommendation", which is not in the glossary, in the base list, or in "Terms in this skill" of SKILL.md, and the file gives the item only as the heading "When you recommend text to move" (line 87).

advisory.heading: When you write a sentence
advisory.text: When the write job has Claude Code and Codex or OpenCode as target platforms, put the text for all target platforms in `AGENTS.md`.
advisory.problem: In skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/loading-rules.md, line 35, the words "Claude Code and Codex or OpenCode" can also mean "Claude Code and Codex, or only OpenCode", and with that meaning, the next sentence about `CLAUDE.md` is applicable to a job without Claude Code.
advisory.correction: "When the target platforms of the write job are Claude Code and one or more of Codex and OpenCode, put the text for all target platforms in `AGENTS.md`."
